content: Glucocorticoid therapy, including the use of medications such as prednisone, has a significant impact on blood glucose regulation. These medications often lead to an increase in blood glucose levels by approximately 10–15%, regardless of whether the individual has diabetes or not. The hyperglycemic effects of glucocorticoids can persist for several hours, particularly when the medication is administered in the morning. This prolonged effect is attributed to the extended duration of action associated with certain types of steroids.
